dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The primary O-shaped structures exhibit irregular, jagged perimeters with a sharp high-contrast transition from the dark exterior fur to the light-gray interior ring boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a moderate spatial density of small, solid light-intensity pixel clusters interspersed between larger annuli on the lateral flanks.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest dorsal macro-annuli form an irregular elongated quadrilateral oriented along the longitudinal axis of the body.

other_distinctive_markers: Bilateral red specular reflections are visible in the ocular region, characterized by saturated high-intensity red pixel clusters.
